focus.title: Win the fight, then check the offlane
focus.action: After a won fight, check the offlane before chasing the next kill; when Shinbi is unseen and offlane towers fall, one player goes back to defend while the rest take the nearest tower.

14.9.call: Enemy Mini Prime came just before this 3-2 win around the duo lane, then the offlane outer fell and allied Fangtooth followed. Once the fight is won, send one player toward the offlane.

27.1.call: After the duo-lane fight won 3-0, the enemy mid inner fell, then Bayle killed Lt. Belica before allied Primal Fangtooth. After a sweep, Lt. Belica waits for Bayle to show before chasing.

32.1.call: Crunch and Legion scored all three kills in the enemy half while Shinbi had no kill or death credited. When Shinbi is missing from a late fight, one ally guards the base.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Secured every allied Fangtooth, the Primal Fangtooth and the Shaper, plus the game's most objective damage at 31,186. Keep owning the pits whenever two lanes can follow.
Two deaths outside any detected fight, both to Renna, and enemy Mini Prime came shortly after the first. When Renna is missing from mid, clear camps only behind a ward.
One ward against a 7.1 norm while Bayle cleared 100 minions in the allied jungle. If wards were equipped, cover both jungle entrances before each camp respawn.
54384ecf-9ebe-4fd5-9fd9-2370328685cb: Twenty wards, one more than Phase, with 35,470 damage mitigated and no death before minute ten. Keep that floor and ward the offlane approach once the offlane outer falls.
Kill participation sat at 41%, and both deaths went to Murdock on the duo lane. When Bayle or Shinbi dives Legion, save Skewer for that diver.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: No armor in the build while taking 15,422 physical hero damage, the game's most. Against Bayle next game, sidestep the Kingslayer dash during the charge-up and add armor.
A hell of a rotation: Renna, Phase and Murdock died on the duo lane in the enemy half, then allied Primal Fangtooth followed. Repeat that trip when the duo fights.
Zero objective damage, the only player of ten at zero. After a won fight in the enemy half, join the nearest tower siege behind a minion wave.
8056c0e2-9072-49e2-812c-09466de1bc08: Team-high 29,070 hero damage, four kills on Bayle and the enemy offlane outer tower. Keep turning kills into structures that way whenever Shinbi is dead or seen elsewhere.
The allied offlane inner fell in the same window as the duo-lane kill on Bayle. Call the rotation before leaving the offlane.
f2d73949-6946-4f8b-b132-d85fda14699c: Game-high 19,671 gold and 13.6 CS a minute against a 10.2 norm, yet team-low 27% kill participation. Once the enemy duo outer falls, join the next mid fight.
Three of five deaths went to Murdock, first blood included. Stay out of Static Trap zones and step into the fight only after Buckshot is used.

matchup: Bayle was the jungle opponent: one kill on Bayle, no death to Bayle, field lane record 51.3% in 233 games.
Renna landed two of three deaths; Stupor's sleep is the Renna ability to wait out before committing.
build: Berserker's Axe is the one piece of the 59.3% best core built; Augmentation and Draconum never came.
Forticus was the build's only armor: 55 physical armor against Bayle's physical damage, plus tenacity against Cursed Edge's stun.
Rapture and Tyranny were bought last, just before enemy Orb Prime, so the earlier fights ran without both items.
eternal: Nihil's Doom adds power and both armors for each 3s of hero combat; level-ups and takedowns raise the gains 20%.
This jungle field is a toss-up: Pilow leads, with Lotus and Nihil statistically even. Sound keep.
Growing Threat with Adaptive Plating is the best Nihil pair in this field. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Combo Crunch: Cross Crunch damage grants 7.5% total attack speed for 3s, stacking up to four times.
Combo Crunch leans ahead of Lunge Crunch in this jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Glacial Colosseum gives allies on the ice 12% physical power and 12% movement speed, slowing enemies 10%.
Gravitum is clearly the field's best crest for this jungle role; Iceskorn Talons, the most played, ranks well below.
improvement: Field buys Salvation 26% into Bayle against a usual 18%, winning 52.2%: tenacity plus a low-health shield.
Anti-heal (Tainted Blade) was NOT built into three self-healing kits: Renna, Phase and Bayle.
Gravitum over Iceskorn Talons trades the team ice sheet for an infinite-range projectile that grounds the first hero hit.

The allied duo died once before minute ten, the enemy duo never; Phase finished 0/4/9 with 17,800 healing.
build: Dynamo makes an immobilized enemy take 8% more damage for 2.5s, a fit for the Skewer suppress.
Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take 10% more magical damage and halves enemy tenacity.
The 60.8% best core, Forticus, Tainted Guard and Transference, never made the build.
eternal: The field ranks Lotus first in this support toss-up, with Idrisil statistically even. Sound keep.

Mending with Glacier is the best Idrisil pair; the Frost Snap and Icy Touch run sits under the sample floor.
augment: Wanton Warden regenerates health equal to 4-7% of damage taken over 5s, rising with hero level.
Zap O' 9-Chains leans ahead in this support field; Wanton Warden, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Rift Snatcher dashes and pulls nearby heroes; Visionary raises the ward cap from 2 to 3.
Rift Walkers leans ahead in this support field. Sound keep.
improvement: Anti-heal was NOT built into Renna, Phase and Bayle; Tainted Guard or Tainted Bastion fills that need.
Zap O' 9-Chains over Wanton Warden: the next basic attack after a cast zaps nine enemies, giving up damage-taken regeneration.

The deaths came from elsewhere: three to Bayle and two to Murdock, against one to Renna.
build: Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings is the most played core into Renna, 56.8% in 148 games: on core.
Noxia's Dark Matter adds 6% of max health as damage when a separate ability hits a marked hero.
Caustica, finished last, ignores 35% of magical armor.
eternal: Vesh deals 7% of ability damage on heroes, plus 0.4% per minute, again as damage over 3s.

augment: Devastating Bombs: Void Bomb deals 15% more damage to isolated targets.

crest: Anima grants a shield, 20% magical lifesteal and 10% movement speed for 8s.
Soulbearer leans ahead in this midlane field. Sound keep.

Combat Veteran over Devastating Bombs: passive experience and 2.5% movement speed, giving up bonus bomb damage on isolated targets.
Lotus over Vesh is the field-backed Eternal swap, trading the ability burn for random gains every takedown.

matchup: Shinbi was the lane opponent: one kill on Shinbi, two deaths to Shinbi, field lane record 51.7% in 67 games.
Shinbi's ultimate wolves strike every hero recently damaged by Shinbi's abilities, and the E grants shields.
build: Tainted Scepter came second: Blighted Spells cuts healing 45% for 4s on magical damage.
Timewarp and Wraith Leggings, two of the 61% best core, never came; Soulbinder and Azure Core took the slots.

eternal: Vesh burns 7% of ability damage on heroes over 3s; Mind Rot adds 2% of current health.
Aion is clearly the field's best Eternal for this offlane role; Vesh, the most played, ranks second among well-sampled picks.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair here; Tithe of Death with Mind Rot has too few games to rank.
augment: Cursed Infestation: Hive deals 10% more damage with 10% more range.
Toss-up in this offlane field: Cursed Infestation leads, with Ritual Of Death even. Sound keep.
crest: Soulbearer is clearly the field's best crest for this offlane role. Sound keep.
Anima is an active: press Anima as fights open for the shield and 20% magical lifesteal over 8s.
improvement: Anti-heal need met with Tainted Scepter into Renna, Phase and Bayle; a sound keep.
Aion over Vesh is the field-backed swap: mana regeneration and gold from spell damage, giving up the damage-over-time burn.
Timewarp over Azure Core restores the best core's haste, giving up the low-health shield and mana stacking.

matchup: Duo was this carry and Riktor against Murdock and Phase; field lane record into Murdock is 54.1% in 1,264 games.
Long Arm of the Law ignores all physical armor; armor still blunts Murdock's physical basic attacks.
build: Malady is the one piece of the 60.1% best core built; Vanquisher and The Perforator never came.
Tainted Trident, finished last, cuts healing 45% for 3s on any physical damage.
Infernum's Cinder ignites at four Kindling stacks for max-health damage over 2s.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero hit by a basic attack: more damage dealt to that hero, less damage taken from that hero.
Xyris leans ahead in this carry field; Thraex, the most played, ranks well down the list.
Savage Strikes with Rallying Roar is the best Thraex pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Scorched Earth: Frag Order and Saturation Charge mines leave napalm zones, and Orbital Sanction drops one every 0.5s.
Scorched Earth is clearly the field's best carry augment here. Sound keep.
crest: Purifying Strike cleanses all debuffs, then the next hit deals 4% max health true damage, doubled after a cleanse.
Witchstalker leans ahead in this carry field. Sound keep.
improvement: Physical armor was NOT built while Murdock kept killing; the anti-heal need was met.
Equinox adds 20 tenacity and a low-health shield, the listed tenacity answer to Murdock.
Xyris over Thraex is the field-backed swap: bonus damage growing with units killed, giving up the marked-target damage cut.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Phase. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Shinbi. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
ourKits.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
ourKits.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
ourKits.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

ourKits.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
ourKits.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
ourKits.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
ourKits.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

ourKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
ourKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
ourKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
ourKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
ourKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

ourKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
ourKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
ourKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
ourKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
enemyKits.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
enemyKits.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
enemyKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
enemyKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
enemyKits.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
enemyKits.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
enemyKits.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
enemyKits.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

enemyKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
enemyKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
enemyKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ability.name: Shots Fired
ability.what: Landing 5 successful Basic Attacks will cause Murdock's next Basic Attack to have 400 increased range and deal (+36-60%) bonus damage.

loadout.plain: Shots Fired, the empowered shot after 5 basic attacks, pierces through units and reaches even further. Poke heroes standing behind their minion wave.

loadout.name: Demiurge
loadout.text: Increase stats gained from Items (excluding passives) by 10%, and damage dealt by Item Effects by 10%.

loadout.name: Tri-Core
loadout.text: Deal 5% bonus damage On-Hit, randomly Physical, Magical or True.
loadout.plain: Murdock's basic attacks deal 5% bonus on-hit damage of a random type: physical, magical or true. A plain damage boost, adding the most while Hot Pursuit has Murdock attacking fastest.

loadout.name: Cursed Corrupted
loadout.text: Convert each 1% Critical Chance into 0.8 Ability Haste (you lose the converted crit stat).
loadout.plain: Turns each 1% critical chance into 0.8 ability haste and removes that crit. Useful only with crit items: Buckshot, Static Trap, Hot Pursuit and Long Arm of the Law then return sooner, but basic attacks stop critting.

loadout.name: Liberator
loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes slows, stuns and other debuffs and gives a short shield. Save it for when you get caught, then Hot Pursuit away or keep shooting.

gameFlags.summary: Lt. Belica kept dying to Bayle (3 of 6)

gameFlags.summary: Legion kept dying to Murdock (3 of 5)
evidence: Legion died 3 of 5 times to Murdock.
Murdock's hard CC: Buckshot (knockback), Static Trap (root).

Play against Murdock: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

bullets: Demiurge raised item stats and item effect damage, so Lightning Hawk's full-Momentum shot and Sky Splitter's current-health hits landed harder; Tri-Core added random-type bonus damage on hit.
Cursed Corrupted swapped all critical strike chance from Lightning Hawk, Necrosis, Vanquisher and Demolisher for ability haste, so Buckshot, Static Trap and Hot Pursuit returned sooner.
Necrosis made Long Arm of the Law deal 15% more damage, and the shot ignores physical armor, so the ultimate hit hard even into high-armor targets.
The Tenth Seal added ultimate damage and ultimate ability haste at level 10; Millennia grew ultimate damage every minute, adding to Necrosis and Spear Of Desolation on Kingslayer.
Vesh turned part of every ability hit on heroes into extra damage over time, so area hits from Skull Crusher, Cursed Edge and Dire Howl kept dealing damage.
Every ability hit set off The Perforator's slow and Tainted Trident's healing reduction; Malady's burst on heroes below 40% health runs on a cooldown that takedowns reset.

Bayle: 33,390 hero damage, 3 of 6 Lt. Belica deaths, and 0 of 3 victims built physical armor.
Crunch took all 3 Fangtooths, Primal Fangtooth and the squad's Shaper: 31,186 objective damage.

focus.action: After each won fight, send one hero back to defend the lane under push before the next prize, and hold Riktor Skewer for Bayle when Bayle dives Legion.
